decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the single storey rear extension will not have an adverse affect upon the adjoining residential occupiers and will be satisfactorily related to the existing house in terms of design given the circumstances of the application. This is compliant with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan. Where the proposal is not compliant with these policies no adverse affects are considered to arise from this.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing house.
